description: This file defines utility types and functions for managing sets of IP networks and IP addresses, including parsing, set operations (insert, delete, difference, subset checks), and conversions to string slices. It is part of the Kubernetes utils package.

methods.name: ParseIPNets
methods.description: Parses a list of CIDR notation strings into an IPNetSet.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Adds IPNet items to an IPNetSet.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes IPNet items from an IPNetSet.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if an IPNet is contained in an IPNetSet.

methods.name: HasAll
methods.description: Checks if all given IPNets are contained in an IPNetSet.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Returns the set difference between two IPNetSets.

methods.name: StringSlice
methods.description: Returns a slice of string representations of the IPNets in the set.

methods.name: IsSuperset
methods.description: Checks if an IPNetSet is a superset of another.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks if two IPNetSets are equal.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in an IPNetSet.

methods.name: ParseIPSet
methods.description: Parses a list of IP address strings into an IPSet.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Adds IP addresses to an IPSet.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes IP addresses from an IPSet.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is contained in an IPSet.

methods.name: HasAll
methods.description: Checks if all given IPs are contained in an IPSet.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Returns the set difference between two IPSets.

methods.name: StringSlice
methods.description: Returns a slice of string representations of the IPs in the set.

methods.name: IsSuperset
methods.description: Checks if an IPSet is a superset of another.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks if two IPSets are equal.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in an IPSet.
